description: This Dart source file defines a localized string management system for a Flutter app, including a localization delegate class for supporting multiple locales and a class providing localized strings for UI components such as app name, menu, cart, etc.

classes.name: AppLocalizationsDelegate
classes.description: A localization delegate class that manages supported locales and loading localized resources for the app.

classes.name: AppLocalizations
classes.description: A class providing localized strings such as app name, menu, cart, and others, tailored for different locales.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the given locale is supported by this delegate.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the localized resources for the given locale asynchronously.

methods.name: shouldReload
methods.description: Determines whether the delegate should reload its resources when a new delegate is provided.

methods.name: _t
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves the localized string for the current locale from a map of language codes to strings.

methods.name: appName
methods.description: Returns the localized string for the application name.

methods.name: heritage
methods.description: Returns the localized string for 'Our Heritage'.
